As I was iterating on roc-redis design, I went through some iterations of the API and I put it all together some findings in a little blog post: https://jaredramirez.weblog.lol/2026/09/validating-values-at-compile-time-in-roc?preview&uncache

it builds on some ideas discussed here: #show and tell > niclas-ahden/roc-non-zero
